review_description: I write this review 8.1.20 for Solar Switch, which probably went out of business in 2015. It is now ~9yrs since my 2.15kW system (10 x 215W Hyundai solar panels & a SG2000 Growatt inverter) was installed ~26.4.11 in Castlecrag NSW 2068, and it is still working. I don't really know how the value for money was then.I mark them down for Customer Service as it was the installer (not the salesman) who warned me of tree shading, and broke off the install to get a study done (I proceeded when he showed ave 85% efficiency over the year - more shading in winter than summer); also my questions to the company on inverter efficiency went unanswered in 2013. Nevertheless, the system is still working. In 3mths to 17.12.19 net FIT to AGL was 554kW (same period prior year 442kW)
I now have a fault in the inverter and have called Solar Switch's number several times leaving a message after voicemail. No response.

Solar Switch is out of business and you should update your website to reflect that. I have a faulty inverter that needs to be fixed or replaced. Their phone number on their website is disconnected, as is my installer's mobile number, and they do not answer emails at all. So I phoned the business next door to them from looking at Google street view photos and was told they disappeared over a year ago.
Never return calls

After 5 years system was working well.  Three months ago had two new solar isolator switches installed (remote solar isolator) switch which are new innovative items that kill all direct current in the panels  when switch activated.  The electrician who made the installation  discovered many defects in the original installation, unsafe wiring system unearthed, problems with panel installation etc. and these problems were fixed at our expense, no reply from Solar sSitch.   Problems continued and after ceo of remote solar isolator  switch attended and located a  plug and play to one of the panels had caught fire and burnt out.  It appears two different male and female plug and play  connections had been used resulting  the plastic  connection melting, a real risk of fire.  Everyone who had an installation done by Solar Switch should have the system checked particularly the connections.   Col.
Can anyone tell me is this company still operating. I cannot get in contact with them. They do not answer calls or emails. Maybe A Current Affair needs to follow this up....

As with when I had my Solar System put in by Solar Switch in 2011 to now there after sale service is absolutely appalling. Not one person in a Management position in 2011 & now 2014 would take any calls & everything is left to the reception staff to make up stories or pass on the company line. I was told to leave a message but alas a week later & still no reply. Once again I called and was told yet again that leave a message and someone will call you. After 4 days still nothing. It seems to me that once Solar Switch has your money they believe they owe you NO after sales service at all and this is evident in my dealing with them. I have never dealt with a company where management have been unwilling to take calls from unhappy clients but this apparently is how they avoid explaining there poor after sales service & no existent warranty that is supposedly 5 years. Solar Switch Management your actions are absolutely disgusting and you should be ashamed at your behaviour. If that is how people who have put their faith in you and dealt with then any bad press you get is well deserved. And yes exactly the same appalling behaviour & excuses 4 years ago

My system had a fault  after inspection. I called solar switch to no satisfaction and had to fix it at my cost. After service is not good, the fact is there is no service once you pay the money,Would not recommend this company at all please avoid you don't want to go through what I have. My advice is don't pay until you get the inspection done.
Poor follow up with the other two suppliers.
Wattson energy monitor has not been configured properly. Currently awaiting response from SolarSwitch to rectify this.

Overall I'm happy with they system that was installed. There were some hiccups along the way which started to frustrate me but eventually these were sorted and all issues were dealt with & all questions asked were answered.I did opt for Solar Switch as they offered a combined payment up front with the option to pay the remaining balance with an interest free payment plan using Certegy.I felt the installation took too long compared to indications when quoted. It was over two months before it was installed and connected after deposit was made.There were some issues getting a 3 phase net meter which put the final connection a couple of weeks behind and once fitted 2 callouts were required before it was set up and working correctly. Although these were minor issues, they did delay the time before the system was fully operational and may have gone on longer had I not taken the time to review performance output of my system against similar sized systems in my region.Although some issues were experienced with the install, they did respond to my concerns and queries and fixed any faults raised. I am happy with the overall performance of the system and I would still recommend Solar Switch as an option if you're looking for a system.
Our clip-lock roof is quite old so 10 days were wasted as the installers were given the wrong fittings.Possibly a closer look at the roof in the first place would have been a better option.
The first thing that caught my attention was the courtesy of the saleswoman and honesty, in showing us what is the best system for us.She never hinted or went for a system higher.
When we made our choice, we knew there was quality and honesty in the person in front of me.Three times, she explained to me what was the best system for us and we knew we could not make a mistake.
No pushy salesperson.Ready information.$0 deposit finance.Helpful every step of the way with non experienced buyer.

The initial contact with Solar Switch rep was informative and the benefits of solar well presented.A fairly hard sell, but the rep's enthusiasm and willingness to negotiate the deal won us over.All things happened when we were told they would.Installation was stress-free, with very obliging tradesmen completing it in only a few hours.On two occasions since installation, operational questions I have put to Solar Switch by phone were answered immediately and to my satisfaction.A bit of a black hole re: feedback from my to-be energy provider so far, but I guess new electricity meters and a farewell call from my present provider means changeover has happened.On these few weeks of fine winter's days, the system is producing up to 12kWh per day, with daily peak generation between 2.4 and 3kW.We would recommend that anyone considering solar power include Solar Switch as a potential supplier.

Carolyn the salesperson was very informative and helpful giving us a wide range of quotes.She seemed to have a good understanding of solar and was not pushy.The installers were efficient and tidy. All in all a positive experience.Thank  you Finn for all the good info on your website - very helpful.
Company delivered the product in a prompt and professional manner. The staff/contractors were wonderful.
So far, everything has been confused, installation etc.
The system has not been installed yet. We are yet to confirm installation date. Panels and inverter have been installed.
All three were very professional with frog solutions not as good as the other two thank you for your assistance.

I haven't got the first electricity bill since installation yet so cant comment on weather it is going to save much money.I believe all 3 suppliers I had give quotes would have done a good job.I ended up going for the Solar switch option because they followed through with there quote and adjusting it to suit my requirements as I changed my mind.Nicholls group didn't have time to do a sight inspection and the only communication I had with them was through email.Mark group did not give competitive written quote but said they would beat the others quotes, however, once I gave them the final prices from from Nicholls and Solarswitch I didn't hear from them again.
SolarSwitch were very good at communication all through the transaction and also followed up after installation to make sure we were happy with the job.
Very happy with the service and the price of the system. It was the best system for the price.
We were misquoted several times and the size of the solar array kept changing.  The installation took 6 months longer than what they said and they were virtually impossible to contact.

Electrical installation was  poorly excuted in that the  solar panel  tile  brackets were poorly placed ,however did not affect operation of Solar Panels. Installation in roofing space not to Australian Standards .
Everything smoothly & all that was promised was kept.

I wouldn't normally post online about my experiences, but as Solar has had such bad press, I thought it would be helpful to tell everyone how good my installation with Solar Switch was. Right from the word go Solar Switch were helpful and very knowledgeable about their products. The install took place within 3 weeks of me purchasing the system, the install team were on time and very courteous and I couldn't be happier with my system.

Thank you Solar Quotes! I appreciated finally getting quotes from reputable companies.To be fair, all 3 quotes we got were fairly competitive with quality products (which I was able to determine from all the fantastic info on the Solar quotes website, I spent hours on there!).We went with Solar Switch because they were able to offer us not only the cheapest price, but I felt the best value for money that we could afford in terms of the brand/performance of both panels and inverters. It is rare for me to take the cheapest quote, as I'm wary of a deal too good, but Solar Switch were great from start to finish - I would recommend them. And we've also been very happy with the way our system is performing so far, only 6wks in and it's been a good summer, but very satisfied!

Solar Switch were great. The consultant was very informative and gave us  lots of ideas on how we could save money on electricity  whether we signed up with them or not. She showed us how we could greatly reduce our power bill by advising us on our individual electrical fittings . She explained everything thoroughly and answered our multitude of questions very well. We had the solar panels installed exactly when she promised they'd be installed. They did a very clean and neat job.

All three recommendations provided quotes, with two visiting site to discuss their proposal.We selected Solar Switch because they provided a larger Inverter for a slightly higher price so that should we wish to upgrade the system later we will not need to add a newer, larger Inverter.Installation was performed very well and the final stage of the meter conversion all went without any issues. Very satisfied with their product and team.

Professional & experienced salesperson and installers,  all questions answered promptly.Information & brochures were readily available  to keep.Communication was clear with touch to base for the customer when required.
I really appreciated the information provided by SolarQuotes website in helping me make an informed decision on which company to go with.

SolarSwitch was responsive, and their paperwork was good.  They met their installation date once agreed, and the installation seems professional.Good choice of equipment available  - Conergy, Silex, Suntech, Trina, and Sunpower panels and SMA, Fronius, Aurora, and Xantrex inverters.  This allow choices to be made on cost or quality basis.I chose 11 Conergy 185 W panels with Xantrex GT 2.8 kW inverter.  Mounting hardware is Conergy.  panels because of 90% capacity warranty at 12 years rather than 10 years as with most panels.  Inverter will allow another 7 panels to be added.

We opted for a system with a greater output per panel and a larger inverter to allow for future expansion. The company we chose has been in the industry for some time, has a very good reputation, and has a well establisher Area Manager structure in Sydney. Everything has been done in a professional, timely manner and confirmed in writing. We couldn't be happier. Installation occurs next week and I am very cofident that it will be faultless.

There is definitely not enough of information out there that is easily understood by the common man.For example you sent me information from the government body and about the closing of the Gross scheme. The others that I spoke with did not provide these details. And they are very relevant details and should be part of the decision taking process of the clients.The products offered by different companies are different and not comparable. Some websites have details of the products and others do not.What is covered under Warranties, and who is responsible for removing / servicing in case of a failure is not advised.How resilient the panels are to hail damage is not advised / easily available.I agree with you that an independent ratings site is needed. I am sure there are a few "cowboys" out there that the public need to know of.

Be sure to have the installer (not the salesman) visually inspect the roof, days if not weeks, before installation.I had the experience, where A company's installers arrived to instal the panels, then decided the roof was to steep to work on.
Research, Research, Research helped me understand the logistics before dealing with the sale peoples hype.

Positive so far. The system was installed by Solarswitch on date stated and electrician installed meter shortly after.Country Energy only supplies limited numbers of meters to electricians & still waiting for Country Energy to do final inspection & turn system on.
I found the salesman honest and he provided a lot of information.  Whereas other salesman from other companies gave me false or misleading information.

I bought a premium product from a long standing Solar supply company, it is all they do, and they also imported the products. I chose them on the basis that they will still be around in the long term and are not  people who have just recently joined the gravy train. The system is working as they said it would. They weren't the cheapest but it was a quality system and quality installation.

Bought the system through Solar Switch while the actual guys that installed it were from Coastal Solar. The paperwork was straightforward to complete. The installation team on the day were very efficient and courteous. They listened to where I wanted items installed and did it as requested. A neat result and I am very pleased.

Purchased  my system during the last week before closure of Qld's 44c tariff rebate scheme. A very hectic, crazy time. I sent out feelers to a lot of suppliers/installers via the Internet including Finn Peacock's site. Got lots of responses with lots of good background information and advice/guidance on solar power installation. Received lots of call backs from suppliers/installers offering advice and deals - overwhelmed almost! As I was working to a budget I had to make a decision balancing costs with the best quality inverter and panels. Based on my research (most helpfully from the Solar Quotes site) and with time running out I made the decision to go with Solar Switch even though they were not a local company but Sydney-based. They made everything easy for me, installation was fast and efficient. Now, the proof (or lack thereof) will be in the pudding as I sit back and await my forthcoming reduced electricity bills and long term trouble-free service... Fingers crossed!
Considered shade issues - advised correct placing of installation.

Solar Switch had the best value for money system, thier customers service was great. They followed up at every step of installation. Any questions were answered over the phone quickly.The warranty for parts/labor was better than most of the other quotes.
Installers were good bunch of guys who explained the process and what to look out for in the future. The company was also helpful and up front with information to assist in my decision making.
Their communication was quick and prompt and they strictly kept to scheduled dates.

Using your tips I had a list of about 20 or more questions for all the company's I spoke to.  I was able to ask the right questions and research the components they use for myself, to get a real understanding of which offered the best price for the best system.  It is true the company's that are shady will not disclose all the information up front and shy from the questions.  There is alot of research to provide the tips and the questions you had available for me to use and for this I am very thankful.  I also believe I now have a future in solar systems sales, it would be such a shame to waste all this new found knowledge.  Thank you so much for helping me make an informed decision.
All too easy.  Everyone should do it.

I obtained quotes from the suppliers of Solar Electricity Systems rather than installers. They gave me a good deal and provided detailed information on what you would get for your money.There was some confusion as to what would be the best metering (Net or Gross Metering). I ended up with Net Metering with the installation of one Smart Meter to replace my Domestic and Off Peak Kwh meters.My new Solar Panels were connected to the grid on 1st July 2011.I changed to Origin Energy as my contract with Integral Energy expired on 26th June 2011. I am at presently seeking clarification from Origin Energy to determine what tariff will be applicable with the Smart Meter and what rebate I will receive from the electricity generated from my Solar Electricity System.

The installers were very professional and as we have cathedral ceilings, were eager to discuss the positions of the panels and the inverter with us to make the installation as unobtrusive as possible. We cannot wait to see the results in the future.
Only Solagex came through with a quote. I got quotes from 2 other suppliers before settling with SolarSwitch. From signing off the order to get the panels installed took 8 weeks.
All went well with no problems
They came when they said they would ,on time.
They have installed the panels & inverters but needed to replace a small part, so they left.I am awaiting the completion & then the connection to the grid.

Solar switch were the first to respond to my inquiries and sent a young but well-informed sales person to visit the site. I found I was happiest to deal with a company that took enough interest to come and visit and discuss our requirements. After that we heard nothing for over a week and felt rather neglected after signing up. After a couple of niggly calls they responded brilliantly, sending a very experienced and professional installer, keeping in touch and completing the job effectively and I believe, well. Solar Switch organised the electrical inspection and we are now producing and using our own electricity, but impatient to have a two way meter installed. I think it might require some chasing up to finish the process. Overall I think that we have bought and had an excellent solar system installed. Here's to the inverter ticking over for many years!

None of the recommended suppliers responded within a week.  One did so only after prompting from SolarQuotes.  One responded more than two weeks later. One never responded at all.  One supplier was rejected because they did not keep their initial appointment and did not ring to cancel or postpone.  Another was rejected because they offered only a one year warranty for workmanship.The list of questions from SolarQuotes was invaluable in helping us make a decision.
We chose a local installer as we believe that they have a reputation within the community to uphold and will be more attentive if any follow-up service is required.

They were helpful regarding a system to fit my limited and awkward roof space. I was able to have SunPower panels and a SMA inverter which was what I had wanted all along. I was doubtful whether the panels would fit so the company arranged for the installer to come out and look at the roof and he rang me that night to confirm that it was perfectly possible to instal this particular system.

In choosing, websites had limited information regarding products.Sales people lacked knowledge regarding products.Most seemed to try to sell on price alone.Companies did not quote what I requested, but quoted other equipment without notice.

Failure to deliver and install the system within the understood time-frame plus the inadequate level of communication from SolarSwitch were, and continue to be, distinct drawbacks.Local installers who handled the main part of the work were testy and not pleasant to have around. I cannot comment on the effectiveness of their relationship with SolarSwitch.It is now approximately 8 weeks since the date (mid-January) that I'd expected the system to have been installed. While the system is now 'complete' it hasn't been connected to the 'Grid'. I've been told that this is because ACTEW can't supply a meter until the end of March - but I have no way of verifying this.In hindsight, I should have paid more attention to bottom line costs and relied less on expectations that the system would be installed by a certain date (and connected to the grid one week later).

Prices do vary from supplier to supplier and so do the systems. More information needs to be provided to the consumer with recommendations on systems. Secondly, there is an additional cost to get a Level 2 electrician to install the Gross meter.Again consumers are not informed of what work needs to be undertaken and can be exploited due to lack of knowledge. Here again further information is needed with approximate costs and if possible referrals of level 2 electricians.This will allow consumers to approach 2 or 3 electricians for quotes reducing the chances of being exploited
great service & easy to contact salesman to find out where install / connection was up to , all done in 6 weeks as quoted
It is advisable to do a good research for valuable information on anything before you make up your mind to proceed with any contract.
So far, I've not yet received the panels but I expect to do so shortly. As such, I cannot comment on installation.

My one complaint is the lack of communication from Solarswitchaustralia following the installation of the panels. I would expect at least phone calls telling me that the are still waiting on Energy Australia to complete the install.Solarswitchaustralia are great in giving you quotes and then installing the system promptly and efficiently but need to keep customers up to date on the completion of the installSo at the moment I have 3kW solar system sitting on me roof which I don't know how well it works. Will I be generating an average of 12 Kwh per day?  I hope to find out real soon.
The system is 2.4 kw sunpower/300watt panels,sma inverter
Had my panels and converter installed 3 days ago. Can't wait for my meter to be installed and start saving.

The information that you provided in your website + the 7day tutorials greatly helped me in deciding the type of Solar Panels and the Inverter for the 1.5 kw system that I,ve seleced.The original 3 quotes I got varied from around $3000 to around $6000. The types of panels and inverters also varied a lot. I was particularly keen on the quality fo the system and did some further reasearch before deciding on Sun Power 300w panels and SMA S/B 1700 inverter for the 1.5kW system .The people who provided the original quotes were helpful - but almost all had very little history of providing similar service and the selection of panels / inverters they provided were very limited. Solar Switch,the company I've selected, provided 5 different options with very good quality products.

Little joy with your nominated suppliers. Much digging to locate local suppliers October November 2009. Now there are plenty of ads for many suppliers. My system is now installed along with gross feed in metering but no credits yet. A few other PV sytems are appearing on roofs in the area. I still need advice on use/reading of the meters to better apreciate its value.

Had a lot of delay from country energy supplying the equipment and the delay in turning the system on even though the installer was fully qualified. There was still two months delay in turning the system on. The installer was the only one in my area.

Lack of space meant that more efficient panels were used 8 in number but cost $2000 per panel.It is possible that another company would have installed standard panels differently to fit on the roof which was only 3mt from gutter to ridge cap.Installer did not connect the type of panel correctly to the inverter and had to return to fix them.Delay in installing the meter as the electrictian lost the email requesting the work.System is now working fine but cannot be expanded in the future due to the type of panel and inverter used, Sunnyboy 2500

Despite a number of suppliers looking at our roof on Google and quoting it became clear to us that we did not have space for a lot of panels.  We have a large roof but funny angles.  Only Todae told us that they couldn't do it.  In the end we went with Solar Switch because they were able to supply Sunpower 300 panels which gave us a system size of 2.4kW.  Even then the saleperson signed us up for a 3kW system without proper assessment and the installers turned up with 10 panels but could only fit 8 on the roof.  We were also inclined to get the Sunpower panels as they were marketed as "premium" products.  We have had so many bad experiences with cheap products from China and did not wish to take a risk with such a large investment.  Despite our annoyance we were happy with the installers.  The system was installed only last Saturday.

Solarswitch failed to notify Energy Australia that my Solar power system was installed and running.They admitted this oversight subsequent to my calling them about three weeks after installation, querying when I was likely to have my gross meter installed. So this could result in my gross meter installation taking up to nine weeks, if the supposed six weeks Energy Australia installation backlog is taken into account.
the system is 3.5kw
Solarwsitch is a good installer but stay clear of Beyond Building Energy - they held a $3500 dep for 8 months without stock to put a system up  i almost gave up on puting solar on

Time lag between system installed and system working to achieve clean energy going into the gridA problem for all providers owing to the interest shown by Australians to foster clean energy, something the politicians are finding very diificult to understand  from ALL parties,  including the greens.A lot of our other neighbours have either solar hot water and solar panels, and we are in the 55+ to 80 age group.So as Australians we recognise that from little things big things grow, we are doing our little bit to help the planet.
Your 7 day information was very helpful
your service was fine, thanks
